scope: Nepal medical discovery — Patan Academy of Health Sciences

verifiedFacts.claim: PAHS publishes an MBBS programme through its School of Medicine and identifies mandatory undergraduate medical-intern training.
PAHS's current foreign-category fee schedule lists MBBS tuition totals of USD 70,000 for SAARC and USD 84,000 for non-SAARC students, plus registration, council, insurance and listed hostel charges.
PAHS's MECEE-BL 2026 admission notice gives foreign MBBS admission-payment figures and document requirements including secondary and higher-secondary records.
PAHS publishes foreign MBBS hostel terms: USD 50 monthly fee, USD 200 refundable deposit, annual advance payment, and non-mandatory hostel use.

holdReasons: No independent current programme recognition/accreditation evidence was established for the necessary recognition badges.
A complete current programme duration/curriculum, language of instruction and clinical-placement evidence packet was not completed.
Foreign-category total fees and their instalments need a complete current admissions-route context before a public payload can make a fee claim.
nextAction: Verify current programme recognition and clinical/internship route, then complete programme duration, language and admissions evidence before packaging the foreign MBBS route.
